8._section_summary: This section reports mediation analyses testing body appreciation as a mediator between several predictors (discrepancy and order perfectionism, attachment anxiety, restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages) and intuitive eating, using bootstrap procedures (1000 samples) and bias-corrected CIs. Three of four indirect effects were significant: full mediation for discrepancy perfectionism (β = -.06, p < .01, CI = -.087 to -.033) and partial mediation for attachment anxiety (β = -.02, p < .05, CI = -.047 to -.005) and restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages (β = -.03, p < .05, CI = -.060 to -.007); the order perfectionism indirect effect was not significant (β = .02, p > .05, CI = -.001 to .032).
